overview.description: The Pacer Solactive Whitney Future of Warfare ETF (FOWF) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the Solactive Whitney Future of Warfare index. The fund is passively managed to hold stocks from developed market countries associated with sectors determined to shape defense programs of the US and its allies. Stocks are selected based on a proprietary rating system and weights holdings based on defense spending data from the US Department of Defense (DOD) FOWF was launched on Dec 17, 2024 and is issued by Pacer.
